purpose: Reinvent MTS strategy/chromosome/gene discovery without arbitrary session-count tenure constraints and preserve complete executable provenance.

governance.development: consumed DEV50 only for first search
governance.preserved50: CLOSED until architecture and finalist selection are frozen
governance.test17: CLOSED; consumed diagnostic only after preserved50 stage if explicitly authorized
governance.historical_artifacts: immutable evidence; do not delete or overwrite

principle: GA discovers causal conditions for ENTER, CONTINUE, REPLACE, EXIT_TO_SAFE and regime-permitted SHORT; time held is an outcome, never a gene or rule.

state_authority.path: NORMAL -> A/B/C -> DEFENSIVE -> recovery evidence -> R1 -> NORMAL

decision_semantics.continue: incumbent remains while it qualifies and is not displaced under evolved replacement rule
decision_semantics.replace: only causal score/evidence/portfolio-value conditions may displace incumbent
decision_semantics.exit: qualification failure, state prohibition, risk rule, or SAFE dominance

validation.selection: Pareto with deterministic tie breaks; no outer-fold outcome used to tune that fold
validation.randomness: all stochastic operations use recorded explicit seeds

reproducibility_required_outputs: fitness for every evaluated chromosome or content-addressed shard
finalists frozen before next evidence stage
unit/smoke tests for chromosome serialization and deterministic replay
Backblaze archive plus checksum after run
explicit_non_goal: Do not recreate the lost GA by fitting its remembered 10-session result. Reinvent and test the strategy under the horizon-free governance above.
